assistiveText.description: Text that goes below the input to help the user understand the input

invalid.description: Highlights the field red and shows message below (if string) to indicate an error

loadingType.description: Change the type of loading indicator to spinner or glimmer.

multiline.description: Whether the input is a multiline input.

onClear.description:
Callback called when the user clicks the ClearAction button. Should clear the value passed.
To disallow clearing set the clearable prop to never

placeholder.description: Hint text that goes above the value once the field is filled out

placeholderMode.description:
Controls how the placeholder text is displayed.
- normal: the placeholder text will be displayed in the normal placeholder position
- mini: the placeholder text will float above the input value
- hidden: the placeholder text will not be displayed

prefix.description: Symbol to display before the text input

showClearAction.description: Adds the ClearAction that will call the onClear handler when pressed

styleOverride.description: Custom styling to override default style of the input field

suffix.description: Symbol to display after the text input

type.name: { icon?: IconNames; label?: string; onPress?: () => void; }

toolbar.description: Add a toolbar below the input field for actions like rewriting the text.

toolbarVisibility.description: Change the behaviour of when the toolbar becomes visible.
